name: Primordial Blast keeps its highest rank on the bar after an Elemental Mastery transform (#12691)
contract: Report #12691: a level 24 Runemaster's Primordial Blast rank 3 (502824) on the bar 'reverts back to rank 1 after a
time'. The Elemental Mastery transforms (Ignis 713003 and the others) replace Primordial Blast with an elemental
blast (Ignis: 712668) through SynchronizeAscensionTalentReplacements. The lower ranks 800732 and 502823 stay active
beside rank 3, so every rank is replaced, and the sync applied and lifted those replacements in spell ID order:
800732 (rank 1) came last. When the transform ended, the last SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL the client received turned the
blast button back into rank 1, and the replacement's saved origin was rank 1, so the next save and login kept rank 1.
The sync now walks the ranks from lowest to highest, so the highest rank is applied and restored last. The
Primordial Blast ranks are fixtures learned directly; a button holding rank 3 must be saved as rank 3 while the
transform is up, after it ends and after a relog.

steps.label: SETUP: Ignis replaces rank 3 with its elemental blast
SETUP: the bar shows the Ignis blast
FIX: during the transform the button is saved as rank 3
FIX: after the transform the button is saved as rank 3, not rank 1
